title: InclusiveShift-HAR: An Auditable Participant-Exclusive Benchmark for Physical-Ability Generalization in Smartphone Activity Recognition
description: Provisional research software for auditable, participant-exclusive released-block evaluation of ability-associated population shift in smartphone inertial human activity recognition. InclusiveHAR v4 trial boundaries are unrecoverable, so this is not claimed to be trial-safe. This metadata does not assert confirmatory results, fairness, clinical validity, state-of-the-art performance, publication acceptance, or a minted DOI.
notes: Apache-2.0 covers repository-authored material only. Third-party datasets, legacy coursework artifacts, checkpoints, papers, and figures retain their own licences and citations. This file prepares future release metadata and does not represent an existing public release or DOI.
